messages:
Noah (marketing): Quick flag  seeing a bunch of HS leads marked unowned in the last 20m. Some are reprocessed later and create duplicate owner assignments.
Zara (revops): Looking. HubSpot deliveries show intermittent 502s from enrich-proxy; hubspot retries + our RR lambda retry logic sometimes replays and a second assignment can win.
Eli (ops): Root cause may be race between RR lambda and enrich callback. RR assumes enrichment property exists on first deliver. If enrich comes later, owner may be reassigned by later workflow.
Sofia (growth): Impact on webinar nurture? duplicates = multiple nudges. Oof.
Marcus (sales): Also causes lead-owner confusion; AEs see owner flip. We need a clear fallback policy.
Eli (ops): Propose immediate mitigations: 1) introduce router guard: only allow reassign if last_assigned_ts older than claim_window AND fallback_count < 2; 2) set claim_window FF from 90s -> 600s temporarily; 3) tag fallback leads with `fallback_count` and `fallback_reason=enrich_delayed`.
Zara (revops): +1 on tagging. Also want to capture `previous_owner` when reassign happens so we can audit.
Noah (marketing): Can we keep webinar automations paused for leads with `fallback_reason` until we clear them?
Sofia (growth): Yes, add condition in nurture: `fallback_reason IS NULL`. We'll resume once enrich flag present.
Eli (ops): Patch snippet for FF: 
```
PATCH /api/feature-flags/lead.claim_window
{ "value": 600, "rollout": "canary:5%->25%->100%" }
```
Router rule (pseudo): 
```
if (!lead.enriched && lead.fallback_count < 2 && now - lead.last_assigned > claim_window) {
  assign_to_overflow();
  lead.fallback_count += 1;
  lead.fallback_reason = 'enrich_delayed';
}
```
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-proxy 5xx spike detected 0.3% -> 11% (11:20 - 11:28 UTC). Auto-backoff started.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled by eli.ops: ff-lead-claim-3770012345-canary
Zara (revops): Also propose a short-term metric: "owner_flip_rate" for the past 2h. If > 1% we keep safety net. I'll add dashboard and incident tag `enrich-3770012345`.
Marcus (sales): For routed leads, please add HS visible note: "Assigned via fallback_enrich (do not duplicate outreach)" and create an internal view for AEs to filter these.
Noah (marketing): I'll send a 1-paragraph note to #sales-ops and pause webinar sends for fallback cohort.
Eli (ops): Canary started at 11:33 UTC. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/leadflow/routing?panel=owner_flip
Sofia (growth): After stabilization, can we A/B different claim_windows (90s vs 300s vs 600s) to find best tradeoff?
Zara (revops): Love that. I'll set up experiment flags once we stabilize. Postmortem action: make enrich callbacks idempotent and ensure HS retries don't create multiple deliveries. I'll own consolidating.
Noah (marketing): Thanks all. Keep thread live with any rollback requests.
